blocks.text: MADRID — Police arrested 128 people overnight in Barcelona over alleged acts of vandalism, damage to public property and looting, Catalan regional police said on Sunday. Seventy-three of those arrested were minors and their cases will be referred to the juvenile prosecutor’s office, Catalan police chief Silvia Cata told Spanish media outlet 3CatInfo.
